Accreditation.description: Represents an accreditation, which is a collection of properties granted by an accreditor.

accreditedBy.description: The identifier of the entity that granted the accreditation.

message.description: The message for the error as an i18n key.

properties.description: Any additional information for the error.

stack.description: The stack trace for the error.

Federation.description:
Represents a federation, which is a group of entities forming a trust hierarchy.
Federations define the root authorities and the schema for properties they manage.

rootAuthorities.description: List of root authority IDs associated with this federation.

revokedRootAuthorities.description: Account IDs of root authorities that have been revoked and are no longer trusted.

Governance.description:
Represents a governance entity in a federation hierarchy.
Governance entities are trusted entities that can accredit or revoke delegations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the governance entity.

accreditationsToAccredit.description: Map of accredited-by ID to the list of accreditations that grant the right to accredit others.

accreditationsToAttest.description: Map of accredited-by ID to the list of accreditations that grant the right to attest properties.

properties.description: The set of properties this governance entity covers.

accreditedBy.description: The identifier of the entity that granted the accreditation.

accountId.description: The account id of the authority to add.

rootAuthorities.description: The root authorities to be included in the federation.

namespace.description: The namespace of the connector to use for the federation, defaults to component configured namespace.

valid.description: Whether all provided properties are valid.
Whether the provided property is valid.

Property.description: Represents a named property with optional allowed values, a condition, and a validity timespan.

name.description: The property name, can be dotted form.

allowedValues.description: The allowed values for this property, if empty, any value is allowed.

PropertyCondition.description: Describes the condition and constraints of a property within a hierarchy.

PropertyConstraintType.description: Type representing the possible condition types.

anyOf.description: Value must contain a specific substring.
Value must start with a specific substring.
Value must end with a specific substring.
Value must be greater than a specific value.
Value must be less than a specific value.

PropertyType.description: Type representing the possible property types.

PropertyValue.description: Describes the value of a property.

RootAuthority.description: Represents a root authority in a federation hierarchy.

id.description: The ID of the root authority.

accountId.description: The account ID of the root authority.

Timespan.description: Represents a timespan in a federation hierarchy.

validFrom.description: Valid from as bigint string so it can be serialized accurately.

validTo.description: Valid to as bigint string so it can be serialized accurately.
